verdict.rationale: pnpm's GitHub README explicitly claims 'Up to 2x faster than the alternatives (see benchmark)', pointing to a benchmark section, and community reports corroborate real measured speed differences (e.g. 15s vs 35s CI installs, and separate Rust-rewrite benchmarks showing 3x/29x gains). However the evidence pack never shows the actual benchmark methodology, dataset, or independent reproduction — only a pointer to 'the benchmark' and scattered anecdotal timing comments. Missing for 10: the actual published benchmark table/methodology, third-party reproducible benchmark results, and comparison details beyond anecdotal HN timings.
